detached_structure.evidence: A small gray-roofed structure sits just south of the main house, and another small dark-roofed building is near the car at the upper edge of the outline. Either may be an attached wing or a shed.
detached_structure.detail: Small gray-roofed annex or shed beside the house

signals.notes: Long, narrow, heavily wooded lot. The main house has a reddish-brown roof with some staining and debris, and dense canopy covers most of the rear yard. A light-colored car is parked near the upper boundary, close to the neighboring property.
